en: Hand-colored postcard view of a historic railway station building labeled "Kötzschenbroda. Bahnhof." A large, ornate multi-story station with mansard roof stands to the left, with people walking in front and a clock mounted on the façade. To the right are stairs leading up to the tracks behind a high retaining wall, and a fenced area and advertising column in the foreground. The sky has a soft gradient suggesting sunset or sunrise.
